subject: english
question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the error segment in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

After they had eaten a delicious homemade dinner, / the family gathered around the fireplace / to share stories and laughter.

options.text: After they had eaten a delicious homemade dinner,
the family gathered around the fireplace

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"error"** means a mistake or inaccuracy; something that is incorrect. (त्रुटि)

 
 
• **Example: **There was an **error** in the calculation, which led to incorrect results.
 
 
 
• **"No error"** indicates that the sentence is free from mistakes and is grammatically correct. (कोई त्रुटि नहीं)
 
 
• **Example: **After reviewing the document, the teacher found no error in the essay.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that** the sentence provided is grammatically correct and free from errors.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **'Correct answer'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: After they had eaten a delicious homemade dinner** (जब उन्होंने एक स्वादिष्ट घर का बना रात का खाना खा लिया था): This part of the sentence is grammatically correct.

 
 
• **Example:** After they had eaten a delicious homemade dinner, they decided to watch a movie.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: to share stories and laughter** (कहानियाँ और हँसी साझा करने के लिए): This part of the sentence is also grammatically correct.
 
 
• **Example: **They gathered around the campfire to share stories and laughter.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: the family gathered around the fireplace** (परिवार चिमनी के चारों ओर जमा हुआ): This part of the sentence is grammatically correct as well.
 
 
• **Example:** The family gathered around the fireplace to enjoy the warmth.
 
 

 

3b:T58a,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
